description: Split a list of names into random teams or groups of even size, and show them as cards in the chat. Use it for class groups, project teams, game sides, rotations. Give either how many teams or how many people per team. Works without an account.

entries.description: The names or options, one per item, exactly as the person gave them. Repeating a name gives it another slot (another chance), as on the NameWheel website.

team_names.description: Names for the teams, in order. Default Team 1, Team 2...

team_size.description: How many people per team, instead of a number of teams.

teams.description: How many teams. Default 2 when team_size is not given.

title.description: A short title for the wheel, such as 'Period 3 cold call' or 'Who presents first'.

name: make_teams
title: Split into random teams
